// Synthetic Tormenta20 bundle for tests/audit.test.mjs. Read as text by the audit; the test also evaluates it to
// compare the indexed text with Function.prototype.toString.
class Base {
	get isSuppressed() {
		return false;
	}
}

class ItemT20 extends Base {
	rollDamage(options = {}) {
		// collects "@danoALQ"
		return ["@danoALQ", options];
	}
	static create(data) {
		return new ItemT20(data);
	}
	static get label() {
		return "item";
	}
	set value(v) {}
}

let Legacy$1 = class Legacy {
	manage() {
		return "legacy";
	}
};

class Legacy {
	manage() {
		return "current";
	}
}

class Twice {
	run() {
		return 1;
	}
}

{
	class Twice {
		run() {
			return 2;
		}
	}
}

const Holder = {};
Holder.prototype = {};
Holder.prototype.assigned = function (a) {
	return a + 1;
};
Holder.staticAssigned = (b) => b * 2;

function applyEffectChanges(ch) {
	return ch;
}

const applyItemChanges = (ch, qty) => ch * qty;

Handlebars.registerHelper("fieldBonuses", function (path, options) {
	return path;
});
Handlebars.registerHelper({
	other: (x) => x
});

export { Base, ItemT20, Legacy$1, Legacy, Holder, applyEffectChanges, applyItemChanges };
